headline: Legion of Super-Heroes predates Guardians by a decade
post:
Did you know DC's spacefaring super team actually predates Marvel's cosmic misfits by about ten years? According to Screen Rant, the Legion of Super-Heroes first appeared in Adventure Comics nearly seven decades ago. This classic group of far-future saviors features a vast roster including characters like Lightning Lad, Saturn Girl, and Karate Kid. While the Guardians of the Galaxy successfully penetrated the pop culture zeitgeist through blockbuster films, DC's futuristic team has not yet reached that same mainstream level of prominent adaptation. 

Today, the group's current run brings a darker tone where the future is an oppressive dystopia and superheroes are outlawed. Characters like R.J. Brande appear as a murder victim, and issue #3 notes that the universe "does not run on heroism or hope. It runs on . . . sacrifice." 🚀

Have you ever read any of their classic comic book adventures? 

#LegionOfSuperHeroes #GuardiansOfTheGalaxy #DCComics
original_title: 68 Years Later, DC's Answer to Guardians of the Galaxy Is Still Its Most Underrated Super Team

headline: Marvel has recast Tom Holland's Spider-Man
post:
Marvel Studios has brought in a new voice for Peter Parker across multiverse projects, according to Screen Rant. While Tom Holland continues his iconic journey on the big screen, contractual hurdles prevented him from voicing the wall-crawler in television projects. Enter Hudson Thames, who has taken over the role seamlessly in multiple Disney+ animated shows. 

Thames voices Peter in What If…?, Marvel Zombies, and Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man. Fans still get the familiar boyish charm, quick quips, and emotional depth reminiscent of Holland's portrayal. However, the animated series explores entirely new paths, including Peter being mentored by Colman Domingo's Norman Osborn instead of Iron Man. 

It is fascinating to see how the studio navigated these complex rights to expand the hero's adventures onto the small screen. What do you think of this animated Peter Parker? 

#SpiderMan #MarvelStudios #MCU
original_title: Marvel Has Successfully Recast Tom Holland's Spider-Man For The MCU's Multiverse
